Build/DAG sub-tab: layout, closure, inspector, deep links, filters, cycles, no outbound postMessage

[happy] Given the Build tab's DAG sub-tab, when it renders, then every connected FBS sits in a column whose index equals its longest dependency depth from `dependsOnFbsIds` (0 for no dependency) and rows inside a column are ordered by `buildOrder` ascending.

[happy] Given the DAG canvas, when a node is clicked, then it is selected, its upstream closure outlines in the link colour and its downstream closure outlines in the warning colour; a second click on the same node clears the selection.

[happy] Given a selected FBS, when the inspector renders, then it lists status, area, AC count, size, build order, a buildable-now flag, direct and transitive needs, direct and transitive waits-on and an "Open in Specs" link that moves to `#tab=build&sub=specs&entity=<id>`.

[happy] Given a selection, when it is set or cleared, then the hash becomes `#tab=build&sub=dag&entity=<id>` (or drops the entity key when cleared) and a reload with that hash restores the selection and scrolls the node into view.
[happy] Given the DAG toolbar, when the Status, Area, Buildable-now, Critical-path or Show-unconnected filter changes, then the visible nodes update and the current selection is kept.
[failure] Given a `dependsOnFbsIds` cycle on disk, when the DAG renders, then the cycle is reported as a finding in the toolbar area and the remaining non-cycle FBS still render.
[must-not] Given the DAG canvas, when a node is clicked, filtered or inspected, then no `postMessage` is sent to the parent window and no outbound network request is made.
ID lookup: ranking, hash pick, embed/theme round-trip, empty state, no outbound side effects

[happy] Given the review surface, when the SearchButton is pressed or Cmd/Ctrl+F is typed from any tab, then the LookupModal opens; typing an exact id (`REQ-002`) or a prefix (`REQ-00`) ranks that id first and the first result row is pre-highlighted.
[happy] Given the LookupModal, when a word query matches a document's title and another document's snippet, then the title match ranks above the snippet match.
[happy] Given the LookupModal, when a query of exactly one character is typed, then only ids whose identifier contains that character rank, and the title / snippet word-match pass is skipped.

[happy] Given a pre-highlighted result for `US-304`, when Enter is pressed, then the hash becomes `#tab=requirements&entity=US-304`, the Router activates the Requirements tab, opens the REQ-003 ancestor DocRow and the US-304 row, scrolls the target into view and flashes it.

[happy] Given a mount URL `?tab=requirements&entity=US-304`, when the shell first paints, then the Router lands on the same position: Requirements tab active, REQ-003 and US-304 DocRows open, US-304 scrolled into view.

[happy] Given `?embed=1&theme=dark` on the viewer URL, when a result is picked from the LookupModal, then the resulting URL still carries `embed=1` and `theme=dark` in the query string and the hash is `#tab=<tab>&entity=<id>`.

[failure] Given a `./index.json` fetch that returns a non-2xx status or a malformed body, when the LookupModal is opened, then an empty state renders with a reload affordance that re-fetches the index, and no result rows show.

[must-not] Given the LookupModal, when the user types a query, picks a result or closes the modal, then no `postMessage` is sent to the parent window, no outbound network request beyond the `./index.json` fetch is made, and no search term is written to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` / cookies.
Wespa host fixture: iframe shell, theme postMessage, hash-nav embed preservation, cross-origin refusal, three lints, no new outbound postMessage shape

[happy] Given the test-host fixture at `/test-host.html`, when the page loads with the viewer served from the same origin, then the iframe `src` is `./?embed=1&theme=light`, the title block and footer of the iframed viewer are hidden (`<html data-embed="1">`), the tab nav is visible and the host's 56px header plus the resizable sidebar render around it.

[happy] Given the test-host fixture with the iframe loaded, when the host's theme toggle posts `{ type: "rcf-view-theme", theme: "dark" }` to the iframe's `contentWindow`, then the iframe's `<html data-theme>` flips to `dark` without a reload and the content repaints in the dark token set.

[happy] Given the test-host fixture with the iframe loaded at `./?embed=1&theme=dark`, when a hash-only navigation inside the iframe writes `#tab=requirements&entity=REQ-002`, then the iframe's query still carries `embed=1` and `theme=dark` and the viewer's inner `<html data-embed="1" data-theme="dark">` is preserved.

[failure] Given the viewer page listening for `rcf-view-theme` postMessages, when a message with `event.origin` different from `window.location.origin` is delivered, then the message is ignored and `<html data-theme>` is not changed.

[must-not] Given the viewer's `GET /` response, when the three lints run in the test suite, then (a) no `X-Frame-Options` header is set and no CSP `frame-ancestors` directive forbids same-origin framing, (b) `target="_top"` appears zero times in the rendered HTML across every tab, (c) every `localStorage.{setItem,getItem,removeItem}` and shared `storage.*` call site under `src/view/**` uses a key starting with `rcf-view:v1:`.

[must-not] Given the test-host fixture and the viewer page, when either is loaded, then neither posts any outbound message beyond the host's `rcf-view-theme`; the viewer sends no `postMessage` of any shape, and the test-host adds no new postMessage shape.

buildDagLayout places every connected FBS in a column whose index equals its longest dependency depth from dependsOnFbsIds; rows inside a column are ordered by buildOrder ascending.

buildDagLayout carries upstream and downstream closures transitively per node; renderBuildDag outlines upstream in link colour and downstream in warning (checked via data-rcf-dag-role on nodes and edges in the client wiring markers).

buildDagInspectorPayload emits status, area, buildOrder, acCount, buildable, needs and waits (direct + transitive totals) plus needsMeta/waitsMeta for every node, so the client inspector lists them without recomputing the layout.

page-init.js carries the Build/DAG wiring: click-to-highlight writes #tab=build&sub=dag&entity=<id>, applyBuildHash restores the selection and scrolls the node into view (auto-pressing Show-unconnected when the restored node sits in the unconnected lane).

DAG filter chips (status, area, Buildable-now, Critical-path, Show-unconnected) in the DagToolbar; applyDagFilters keeps the current selection intact across toggles; renderBuildDag emits the toolbar with the six filter controls and the unconnected count.
buildDagLayout surfaces cycle members as cycleIds and excludes them from the depth layout; non-cycle FBS still render.
The rendered Build tab slice (DAG panel) does not contain any postMessage( call site; the inspector payload rides on a data-rcf-dag-inspector-data attribute, not a function call.
Viewer UI refresh build stream: Build/DAG sub-tab, filters, inspector and later tab deltas (US-204, US-205, US-18002 and successor USs)
rankLookupRows ranks an exact id match first, a prefix match second and a contains match third; the first ranked row is pre-highlighted in the LookupModal shell.
rankLookupRows ranks a word match in the title above a word match in the snippet when the id does not match; every query word must match title or snippet.
rankLookupRows with a one-character query returns only id matches; the title / snippet word-match pass is skipped.
wireLookup pick writes `#tab=<tab>&entity=<id>` through writeHash; the Router activates the tab, opens every ancestor DocRow and the entity, scrolls into view and flashes the target.
A mount URL of `?tab=requirements&entity=US-304` lands on the same position at first paint via the Router (PR 1 contract), independent of the LookupModal.
A pick with `?embed=1&theme=dark` on the URL leaves both query params in place; only the hash fragment changes. Verified against writeHash + the hash-preservation helpers.

A non-2xx / malformed `./index.json` response renders the empty state (The index could not be loaded.) with a visible Reload index button; no result rows show; the reload affordance re-fetches on click.

wireLookup never calls window.postMessage, never writes to localStorage / sessionStorage / document.cookie, and makes no outbound fetch other than `./index.json`; asserted by a source-level scan of page-init.js (no postMessage, no storage, no cookie writes in wireLookup).

renderTestHostPage returns an HTML5 document with a 56px wespa-header, data-rcf-host-sidebar + data-rcf-host-sidebar-drag markers, data-rcf-host-theme light/dark toggles, an iframe whose src is literally './?embed=1&theme=light' (HTML-entity encoded), a '<script src=./test-host.js defer>' line and zero inline <script> blocks.

The router serves /test-host.html with the fixture body (iframe src + script tag) and /test-host.js with application/javascript when testHost: true; both routes return 404 by default so wespa's reverse-proxy allow-list is unaffected.

src/view/test-host/embed-client.js posts { type: 'rcf-view-theme', theme } to iframe.contentWindow targeting window.location.origin, and its code (comments stripped) contains no localStorage/sessionStorage write (ADR-4136 does-not-persist invariant). The live postMessage round-trip is captured in Playwright evidence (agents/dave/remote-lane/inbox/r-20261002-161325-e2a2/output/evidence/test-host-dark-iframe-flipped.png).

src/view/page-init.js exposes writeHash (reassigns location.hash only, preserving the search string by construction) and stamps data-embed + data-theme on load. Live hash-nav proof lives in Playwright evidence (hash-nav-proof.txt + test-host-iframe-hash-nav-embed-preserved.png).

src/view/page-init.js registers an addEventListener('message', ...) whose first guard returns early when ev.origin !== window.location.origin; cross-origin messages never reach the applyTheme path and <html data-theme> is unchanged.

assertFramingHeaders over GET / returns ok: true (no X-Frame-Options; no CSP frame-ancestors forbidding same-origin). Positive + negative unit cases also pass (refuses on X-Frame-Options present, refuses on frame-ancestors 'none', accepts frame-ancestors 'self').

assertNoTargetTop returns count: 0 across every rendered page (renderPage shell, renderComponentsFixturePage, renderTestHostPage). Also lints the populated dogfood tree render (renderModelToPage) so per-document conditional output cannot smuggle a target="_top" past the test. Positive + negative unit cases cover target="_top" / target='_top' / target=_top.
assertLocalStorageNamespace over the src/view tree returns ok: true; every localStorage/sessionStorage call site resolves to a key starting with 'rcf-view:v1:'.
A grep over src/view/** (excluding test-host/embed-client.js, the sanctioned emitter) finds zero .postMessage( call sites; the embed-client itself posts exactly one shape, 'rcf-view-theme'.
